title: Maestro: Orchestrating AI Coding Agents at Scale

sections.title: Transcript
paragraphs: Too many AI projects? Maestro has your back. A cross-platform desktop app that turns chaos into focus. Run unlimited AI agents in parallel, each in its own isolated workspace. Create playbooks, automate tasks, and even let your agents chat with each other while you stay in the flow.
